# Third-party materials

No third-party source, dataset, or model is vendored here. Record source URLs, versions/revisions, licenses, notices, intended use, and redistribution obligations before adding a dependency or reference. Prefer normal dependency declarations over copied source.

Review source code, datasets, pretrained weights, and hosted-service terms independently. Public availability is not permission to redistribute. Keep downloaded data and weights in ignored local storage; record data review in [DATA_SOURCES.md](../docs/dataset/DATA_SOURCES.md). Do not mix non-commercial data into a commercial-use collection without compatible permission. The project's own source-code license is undecided.
